Stable citation ID

query.meaning: One of the candidate set queries that found the source

title.meaning: Source title or local file name

char_start.meaning: Excerpt start in decoded source, code points

char_end.meaning: Excerpt end, exclusive. Greater than char_start

excerpt.meaning: Verbatim source text from char_start to char_end

excerpt_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 excerpt bytes

citation_ids.meaning: Citation IDs in this set that support the idea

risks.meaning: Known ways the idea could fail

compute_alignment.meaning: Compute alignment score using rubric anchors

novelty_reason.meaning: One-sentence reason for the novelty score

feasibility_reason.meaning: One-sentence reason for the feasibility score

compute_alignment_reason.meaning: One-sentence reason for the compute alignment score

citation_ids.meaning: Evidence behind the scores. Subset of the idea's citations

dependency_flags.meaning: Forbidden dependency IDs that apply. May be empty

eligible.meaning: False exactly when dependency_flags is not empty

rank.meaning: Position, counting up from 1 without gaps

idea_id.meaning: Ranked idea with disposition selected or eligible

producer_node.meaning: Node that will produce the value. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; an existing node ID other than the consumer.

port.meaning: Output port of that node. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; a name in the producer node outputs.

artifact_type.meaning: Artifact type the consumer expects. A mismatch is an incompatible binding. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; must equal the producer output artifact_type.

node_id.meaning: Name of this node in the graph, for example `screening`. Never reused. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the plan.

cc.meaning: The one CC version this node runs. M1 binds one CC per node. Constraint: must match one library entry with selectable_by_planner true.

objective.meaning: One plain sentence on what this node does for the run. Constraint: 1 to 300 characters.

requirement_ids.meaning: Mandatory Brief requirements this node helps satisfy. Constraint: each an ID in the Brief mandatory_requirements; at most 40.

deliverable_ids.meaning: Brief deliverables this node produces or helps produce. Constraint: each an ID in the Brief deliverables; at most 20; requirement_ids and deliverable_ids together hold at least 1 item.

predecessors.meaning: Nodes that must be accepted before this node starts. Extra entries are ordering-only dependencies. Constraint: node IDs; at most 11; includes every future.producer_node of this node; no self reference.

inputs.meaning: Typed bindings for the node inputs. Constraint: at most 16 items; covers every required library input port.

outputs.meaning: Typed outputs the node will produce. Constraint: 1 to 16 items; covers every required library output port.

limits.meaning: Time, model-call and memory ceiling for one attempt of this node. Constraint: each value at most the library max_limits.

suggested_checks.meaning: Extra deterministic checks the Planner wants. The binder may adopt them. They never replace the mandatory bundle. Constraint: at most 8 check IDs, each matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$.

split.meaning: loop or final partition identity, not case IDs

operand.meaning: The treatment aggregate is what gets compared

reference.meaning: What the treatment aggregate is compared with

factor.meaning: Multiplier on the baseline aggregate. 0 for constant, greater than 0 for baseline (cross-field rule checked in output_structure)

offset.meaning: Added after the factor, in the metric unit

reason.meaning: Actionable observed basis; no secret values

cost_amount.meaning: Reported attributable cost, or unavailable; no fabricated estimate

unavailable_reasons.meaning: Unsupported or unobserved fields and basis

name.meaning: Consumer input port name. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the node; an input port of the CC in the library entry.

artifact_type.meaning: Artifact type of the port. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; equals the library input port type.

required.meaning: Whether the node needs this input. The Planner cannot mark a required library port optional. Constraint: must be true when the library port is required.

source_kind.meaning: `accepted_ref` means an input that exists when the run starts (the Brief, the bound search scope or a supplied resource). `future_output` means the accepted output of an earlier node. `host_record` means a record the host supplies without a producing node. Constraint: enum.

run_input_key.meaning: Which run input or host record to bind. The Planner names the key and never writes a ref. Constraint: non-null exactly when source_kind is accepted_ref or host_record. For accepted_ref the value is brief, search_scope or a resource_key of the resource inventory. For host_record the value is screening_rubric, build_receipt, gate_decision_index, screening_result, execution_receipt, provisioning_receipt, environment_lock or run_configuration.

accepted_ref.meaning: Exact bytes of the run input. Only the binder fills this field. Constraint: null in every plan proposal and static template. In a run plan non-null when source_kind is accepted_ref and null otherwise (a host record is bound at dispatch).

future.meaning: Producer node, port and type of the future value. It binds to the gate-accepted output only, at dispatch. Constraint: non-null exactly when source_kind is future_output.

name.meaning: Producer output port name. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the node; an output port of the CC in the library entry.

artifact_type.meaning: Artifact type of the port. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; equals the library output port type.

required.meaning: Whether the node must produce this output. Constraint: must be true when the library port is required.

template_ref.meaning: Frozen internal port and checking template

subject_subnode_id.meaning: Submitted work subject; final assignment aggregates node obligations

profile_ref.meaning: Independently owned criteria and checking profile

id.meaning: Declaration predicate

status.meaning: pass or deferred; unavailable/unknown mandatory checks block

snapshot_ref.meaning: Immutable initial protected ledger snapshot; live recheck is separate

node_remaining.meaning: Remaining node time/calls and effective memory ceiling

routing_reserved.meaning: Routing overhead reservation, included in node totals

tokens_remaining.meaning: Available attributable token balance or unavailable

other_work_reserved.meaning: Reserved other required work; not available to this invocation

role.meaning: Protected attribution label; not Router executor type

admission_ref.meaning: Pinned admission decision; current standing rechecked

invocation_limits.meaning: Existing chosen binding limits; CC execution scope

node_limits.meaning: Parent aggregate limits including routing and verification

budget_snapshot.meaning: Protected independent reservations and available balance

native_structured_output.meaning: Explicit native generation requirement, never inferred from JSON ports

model_allowlist.meaning: Optional narrowing; explicit empty list denies all

quality.meaning: Soft quality preference with evidence basis

enabled.meaning: Protected authorization for an internal selection call

deployment_ref.meaning: Pinned approved selection deployment; required when enabled

model_calls.meaning: Zero when disabled; at most one when enabled

output_tokens.meaning: Bounded billed output including reported reasoning

disclosure_scope.meaning: Permitted bounded selection material; no credentials

time_s.meaning: Nonnegative remaining/reserved elapsed allowance; zero is exhausted or inapplicable

memory_mb.meaning: Positive effective resource ceiling; not additive spend

aggregation.meaning: How repeats combine into value. Equals the blueprint aggregation

delta.meaning: Treatment minus baseline value. Non-null exactly when both values are non-null

repeats.meaning: Raw value of each completed repeat in order. Length equals repeat_count when value is non-null

value.meaning: Registered aggregate of repeats. Null exactly when unmeasured_reason is non-null

unmeasured_reason.meaning: Why no value exists. Null or one of the enum values

repeat_index.meaning: Repeat number within the role, below repeat_count

seed.meaning: Equals blueprint seed for every run (fixed_same_for_all_runs)

subject_ref.meaning: Baseline: blueprint baseline_identity.resource_ref. Treatment: manifest archive_ref

gpu_model.meaning: GPU name. Non-null when gpu_count above 0

gpu_memory_mb.meaning: Memory per GPU. Non-null when gpu_count above 0

captured_at.meaning: UTC ISO 8601, before the first started_at

hash_verified.meaning: Must be true when the lock carries a hash

metric_id.meaning: Equals a blueprint metric_id, unique across findings

threshold.meaning: Non-null exactly when rule_applied is success, falsification or conditional

status.meaning: incomplete exactly when a metric side is unmeasured

notes.meaning: Notes. At least one when status is not plausible

path.meaning: Confined lowercase relative path, unique in manifest

artifact_ref.meaning: Exact content identity; sha256 equals file bytes

resource_ref.meaning: Baseline resource snapshot, one of resource_refs

revision.meaning: Captured immutable revision, equals the snapshot revision

entry_point.meaning: File in the snapshot that Benchmark runs as the baseline

measurement.meaning: Deterministic definition of one repeat value

aggregation.meaning: How repeats combine into one aggregate per arm

target_id.meaning: Brief target_metrics id this metric measures, or null

valid_min.meaning: Lowest value one repeat can physically take, or null for no lower bound

valid_max.meaning: Highest value one repeat can physically take, or null for no upper bound

falsification.meaning: Registered falsification region, disjoint from success

middle.meaning: Classification for results in neither region

conditional_rule.meaning: Registered condition for conditional acceptance. Not null exactly when middle is CONDITIONALLY_ACCEPTABLE

conditional_meaning.meaning: Plain meaning of conditional acceptance. Not null exactly when conditional_rule is not null

must_not_change.meaning: Immutable items. Must contain baseline, validation_data, measurement_functions, outcome_rules

version.meaning: One exact version, no range or marker

syntax_result.meaning: Compile result. not_applicable only for requirements.txt

syntax_detail.meaning: Compiler message, not null when fail

forbidden_imports.meaning: Forbidden modules or dynamic import uses found

cc_name.meaning: Dotted name of the capability capsule. It must equal the name of an entry in the library snapshot. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$, for example research.screening.

cc_version.meaning: Admitted version of that CC. Together with `cc_name` it must match exactly one library snapshot entry. Never a range or `latest`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$.

declaration_sha256.meaning: Digest of the exact declaration bytes. In a plan proposal or static template it must equal the digest in the library entry. The binder rejects a mismatch. Constraint: 64 lowercase hex characters.

check_bundle_id.meaning: The `bundle_id` of the pinned check_bundle record (lowercase dotted snake_case, for example research.screening.checks). Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$.

check_bundle_version.meaning: The `version` of the pinned check_bundle record. Constraint: pattern ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$.

check_bundle_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the exact check_bundle record bytes. Constraint: 64 lowercase hex characters.

checking_profile_id.meaning: The `profile_id` of the pinned checking_profile record (lowercase dotted snake_case, for example research.screening.profile). Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$.

checking_profile_version.meaning: The `version` of the pinned checking_profile record. Constraint: pattern ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$.

checking_profile_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the exact checking_profile record bytes. Constraint: 64 lowercase hex characters.

name.meaning: Port name exactly as in the CC declaration. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique among the same direction of one entry.

artifact_type.meaning: Lowercase snake_case artifact type that flows through the port, for example `candidate_set`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$.

schema_ref.meaning: Exact contract that defines the port content. Two ports are compatible only when both `artifact_type` and `schema_ref` are equal. Constraint: schema URN or field-contract ID.

required.meaning: True when the CC cannot run without this input, or must produce this output.

resource_key.meaning: Key of a resource the CC reads or uses, as in the declaration `needs.resources`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$.

mode.meaning: How the CC uses the resource. Constraint: enum. `exclusive` means no other node may use the resource during the attempt (for example one GPU).

min_quantity.meaning: Smallest quantity needed (for example one GPU). Null when the resource is not countable. Constraint: null or at least 1.

cc_name.meaning: Dotted name of the capability capsule. It must equal the name of an entry in the library snapshot. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$, for example research.screening.

cc_version.meaning: Admitted version of that CC. Together with `cc_name` it must match exactly one library snapshot entry. Never a range or `latest`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$.

declaration_sha256.meaning: Digest of the exact declaration bytes. In a plan proposal or static template it must equal the digest in the library entry. The binder rejects a mismatch. Constraint: 64 lowercase hex characters.

selectable_by_planner.meaning: True when the Planner may choose this CC. False for fixed preparation CCs (Intent, Requirement) and for the Planner itself. The static template may use any entry marked true.

input_ports.meaning: All input ports declared by the CC. Constraint: at most 16 items; names unique.

output_ports.meaning: All output ports declared by the CC. Constraint: 1 to 16 items; names unique.

effect_class.meaning: Effect class from the CC declaration `changes.effect_class`. Constraint: enum.

network_mode.meaning: Network mode from the declaration `needs.network.mode`. Constraint: enum.

resource_needs.meaning: Resources the CC needs, taken from the declaration. Constraint: at most 16 items.

max_limits.meaning: Per-node ceiling taken from the declaration budget. A node may ask for less, never more. Constraint: all values positive except model_calls, which may be 0.

check_pins.meaning: Check bundle and checking profile pinned by protected admission. Null means the version has no admitted bundle. The binder must reject any node that uses a null entry. Constraint: must be non-null for a usable entry.

resource_key.meaning: Key that CC declarations use to ask for this resource. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the snapshot.

kind.meaning: What sort of resource it is. Constraint: enum.

available.meaning: True when the host observed the resource at capture time.

quantity.meaning: Observed count for countable resources (for example 1 GPU). Null otherwise. Constraint: null or at least 0.

ref.meaning: Exact bytes of a supplied file or dataset. Null for hardware and services. Constraint: null or a Ref to immutable bytes.

item_id.meaning: Brief item being covered. Required unless `selector` is set. Constraint: an ID in the Brief mandatory_requirements, deliverables or evidence_obligations. Exactly one of `item_id` with `item_kind`, or `selector`, is set.

item_kind.meaning: Whether the item is a mandatory requirement, a deliverable or an evidence obligation. Set exactly when `item_id` is set. Constraint: enum. An `evidence_obligation` entry names the nodes that produce the evidence; no node tag mirrors it.

selector.meaning: A rule that stands for every Brief item of one kind. Valid only in a static template. The binder expands it into one concrete entry per Brief item before `brief_coverage` runs. Constraint: enum. A plan proposal and a run plan never hold one.

node_ids.meaning: Nodes that cover the item, or every item the selector stands for. The list is the exact inverse of the node tags, except for `evidence_obligation` entries. Constraint: 1 to 12 node IDs; each node must tag this item.

ref.meaning: The accepted artifact the scheduler handed to this port. Constraint: exact bytes of an accepted artifact.

node_id.meaning: Name of this node in the graph, for example `screening`. Never reused. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the plan.

cc.meaning: The one CC version this node runs. M1 binds one CC per node. Constraint: must match one library entry with selectable_by_planner true.

objective.meaning: One plain sentence on what this node does for the run. Constraint: 1 to 300 characters.

requirement_ids.meaning: Mandatory Brief requirements this node helps satisfy. Constraint: each an ID in the Brief mandatory_requirements; at most 40.

deliverable_ids.meaning: Brief deliverables this node produces or helps produce. Constraint: each an ID in the Brief deliverables; at most 20; requirement_ids and deliverable_ids together hold at least 1 item.

predecessors.meaning: Nodes that must be accepted before this node starts. Extra entries are ordering-only dependencies. Constraint: node IDs; at most 11; includes every future.producer_node of this node; no self reference.

inputs.meaning: Typed bindings for the node inputs. Constraint: at most 16 items; covers every required library input port.

outputs.meaning: Typed outputs the node will produce. Constraint: 1 to 16 items; covers every required library output port.

limits.meaning: Time, model-call and memory ceiling for one attempt of this node. Constraint: each value at most the library max_limits.

effect_class.meaning: Effect class of the pinned CC version. The scheduler uses it to decide what may run. Constraint: enum; copied from the library entry.

check_pins.meaning: Mandatory check bundle and checking profile for this node. Frozen. Constraint: copied from the library entry by the binder, never from the proposal.

extra_check_ids.meaning: Extra checks the binder adopted. Empty for a static template. Constraint: subset of the proposal suggested_checks; at most 8.

max_attempts.meaning: Attempts the scheduler may start for this node. Each attempt is a new dispatch record. M1 allows no automatic repair, so the value is 1. Constraint: 1 to 3; M1 plans use 1.

status.meaning: used if the connector answered, unavailable if it failed

citations_captured.meaning: Citations from this connector. 0 when unavailable

description.meaning: What an idea looks like at this score

name.meaning: Dimension name and score field name

id.meaning: Flag ID recorded in scores

match_terms.meaning: Lowercase phrases that always trigger the flag

check_id.meaning: Lowercase snake_case check name, unique in bundle

target_port.meaning: Output port of the target CC

reads.meaning: Records the runner may read. Each in output, inputs, runtime_records

question.meaning: Question answerable from declaration plus output

target_port.meaning: Output port of the target CC that this criterion is asked about. Null means the criterion is asked for every output of the CC. Constraint: null or an output port of the target CC.

result.meaning: pass only when json_print_calls is 1, metrics_key_found is true and missing_metric_ids is empty

json_print_calls.meaning: Number of print(json.dumps(...)) calls found by the AST scan of run_benchmark.py

metrics_key_found.meaning: True when a dict display with the string key metrics is the argument of that call

missing_metric_ids.meaning: Blueprint metric_id values that do not appear as string constants in the file. Empty when none are missing

node_id.meaning: A node of the frozen run plan whose attempt was accepted

gate_decision_ref.meaning: The node-scope gate decision (scope_kind node) with action advance that accepted that node attempt

check_id.meaning: The failing host check ID, for example acyclicity. Null for a Planner report or a gate halt

detail.meaning: Plain statement of what failed or what no CC can cover. 1 to 300 characters

app_build.meaning: Application build identity, equal to readiness `build_id`. Constraint: 1 to 120 characters.

client_contract_version.meaning: Client contract version the app served. Constraint: pattern `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`.

library_snapshot_sha256.meaning: Which CC versions were eligible. Constraint: digest of the library snapshot bytes the run plan names.

plan_policy_ref.meaning: Operator limits on nodes, effects, resources and budget. Constraint: the plan policy the run plan names.

check_bundle_set_sha256.meaning: Which check bundles the library pinned. Constraint: see the rule below.

router_enabled.meaning: Whether the API router was on. Constraint: copied from `cc.router.enabled`.

router_version.meaning: Version of the API router that served the run. Constraint: null exactly when `router_enabled` is false.

node_id.meaning: Node the decision belongs to. Constraint: equals the decision `node_id`.

subnode_id.meaning: Work subnode of a per-output decision. Constraint: equals the decision `subnode_id`. Null for a node-scope decision.

output_port.meaning: Output the decision reviewed. Constraint: equals the decision `output_port`. Null for a node-scope decision and for a halt with no output.

verdict.meaning: Gate verdict, copied verbatim. Constraint: enum `PASS`, `PASS_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATIONS`, `FAIL`, `ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED`, `INCONCLUSIVE`.

action.meaning: Gate action, copied verbatim. Constraint: enum `advance`, `halt`.

recorded_at.meaning: When the gate host stored the decision. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, equals the decision `recorded_at`.

decision_ref.meaning: The decision itself. Constraint: an entry of `decision_refs`.

node_id.meaning: Node dispatched. Constraint: equals the dispatch record `node_id`.

attempt_id.meaning: Attempt dispatched. Constraint: equals the dispatch record `attempt_id`.

started_at.meaning: Dispatch start. Constraint: equals the dispatch record `started_at`.

ended_at.meaning: Attempt end. Null for `interrupted`. Constraint: equals the dispatch record `ended_at`.

outcome.meaning: How the attempt ended. Constraint: the dispatch record outcome enum.

dispatch_record_ref.meaning: Source of these values. Constraint: the dispatch record.

run_id.meaning: Benchmark run ID `<campaign_id>__<case_id>__<config_id>__r<nn>`. It is not the app's `run_id`. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$`.

inventory_id.meaning: Hardware inventory taken before the run. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

sequence.meaning: Which run the values came from. Constraint: min 1. Equals one receipt run `sequence`.

metrics.meaning: The values the run printed in the [output log format](builder.md#output-log-format). A run that printed no valid line has no entry and the payload records `metric_not_emitted`. Constraint: map of `metric_id` to a finite number. Every run has the same key set.

max_attempts.meaning: Proposal attempts in the session, including malformed proposals and visible-test rejects. Constraint: 1 to 20. Default 20.

max_no_progress.meaning: Consecutive attempts without a stronger selection tuple. Search stops when this many pass. Constraint: 1 to 5. Default 5.

wall_s.meaning: Wall time for the whole search, in seconds. Constraint: 1 to 3600. Default 3600 (60 minutes).

per_call_s.meaning: Time limit of one proposal model call, in seconds. Constraint: 1 to 300, at most `wall_s`. Default 300 (5 minutes).

session_query_limit.meaning: Hidden-loop queries this session may spend. The baseline evaluation counts as one query. Constraint: 1 to 30, at most the target profile `session_query_limit`. Default 30.

lifetime_query_limit.meaning: Hidden-loop queries over the lifetime of the registered loop set. A new session never resets it. Constraint: 1 to 90, at least `session_query_limit`, at most the target profile `lifetime_query_limit`. Default 90.

min_pass_rate_gain.meaning: Smallest absolute final pass-rate gain that can qualify a child with more passes. Constraint: 0.05 to 1.

alpha.meaning: Level of the one-sided exact paired binomial test. Constraint: above 0, at most 0.05.

min_timing_gain.meaning: Smallest relative timing gain that can qualify a child with equal passes. Constraint: 0.1 to 1.

noise_multiplier.meaning: The timing gain must be more than this multiple of the calibrated timing noise. Constraint: min 3.

warmup_batches.meaning: Warm-up batches the referee runs before timing. Constraint: exactly 5.

paired_rounds.meaning: Paired timing rounds, in alternating order. Constraint: exactly 7, equal to the target profile `scoring.paired_rounds`.

fixture_units.meaning: Independent fixture units in the hidden-final split. Constraint: min 20.

parent_passed.meaning: Units the parent passed. Constraint: 0 to `fixture_units`.

child_passed.meaning: Units the child passed. Constraint: 0 to `fixture_units`.

gain_units.meaning: Units the parent failed and the child passed (g). Constraint: min 0. `child_passed - parent_passed` equals `gain_units - loss_units`.

loss_units.meaning: Units the parent passed and the child failed (l). Any value above 0 is a protected regression. Constraint: min 0.

pass_rate_gain.meaning: Absolute pass-rate gain of the child. Constraint: equals `(child_passed - parent_passed) / fixture_units`.

p_value.meaning: One-sided exact paired binomial probability. With no discordant unit there is no evidence of a gain. Constraint: equals `P[Binomial(g + l, 0.5) >= g]`. Null exactly when `g + l` is 0.

timing.meaning: Calibrated timing comparison for equal passes. Constraint: non-null when `qualified_by` is `timing_tiebreak`.

warmup_batches.meaning: Warm-up batches before timing. Constraint: exactly 5.

paired_rounds.meaning: Paired rounds, in alternating order. Constraint: exactly 7.

parent_median_s.meaning: Median of the parent batch durations, in seconds. Constraint: above 0.

child_median_s.meaning: Median of the child batch durations, in seconds. Constraint: above 0.

relative_gain.meaning: Relative timing gain of the child. Constraint: equals `1 - child_median_s / parent_median_s`.

calibrated_relative_noise.meaning: Timing noise measured by calibration, as a fraction. Constraint: min 0, from the target calibration.

noise_multiplier.meaning: Multiple of the noise the gain must exceed. Constraint: equals the session `qualification.noise_multiplier`.

min_relative_gain.meaning: Smallest qualifying relative gain. Constraint: at least the session `qualification.min_timing_gain`.

wall_s_limit.meaning: Install time limit, in seconds. Constraint: above 0.

wall_s_used.meaning: Install time used, in seconds. Constraint: min 0.

requirement_id.meaning: Requirement this row reports. Constraint: pattern `^RSI-[1-9][0-9]?$`, a build criterion of the [RSI workbench](../side-systems/rsi-workbench.md#build-criteria).

status.meaning: Result against the criterion. `BLOCKED` and `INCOMPLETE` are never `PASS`. Constraint: enum `PASS`, `FAIL`, `BLOCKED`, `INCOMPLETE`.

evidence_refs.meaning: Reviewable evidence of the result. Constraint: 0 to 16 items. At least 1 for `PASS` and `FAIL`.

note.meaning: Reason for the status, in plain words. Constraint: 1 to 300 characters.

test_id.meaning: Acceptance or security case that ran. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

kind.meaning: Which suite the case belongs to. Constraint: enum `acceptance`, `security`.

outcome.meaning: Result. For a security case, `passed` means the attempt was blocked and its evidence kept. Constraint: enum `passed`, `failed`, `not_run`.

evidence_ref.meaning: Evidence of the run. Constraint: null only when `outcome` is `not_run`.

clause_kind.meaning: Which kind of declaration clause. Constraint: enum `port`, `need`, `effect`, `check`, `failure_mode`.

clause_id.meaning: Which clause. Constraint: 1 to 200 characters, unique within `clause_kind`. The declaration path of the clause, for example `ports.outputs.intent`, `needs.network`, `needs.resources.original_request`, `changes.effects.model-disclosure`, `guarantees.checks.intent_schema`, `guarantees.failure_modes.<reason_code>`. For an undeclared behavior, the same form for the observed thing.

declared.meaning: What the declaration says. Constraint: 1 to 500 characters. Null exactly when `status` is `undeclared`.

observed.meaning: What the run did. Constraint: 1 to 500 characters. Null when `status` is `unused` or `unavailable`.

status.meaning: How the two compare. Constraint: enum `matched`, `mismatched`, `undeclared`, `unused`, `unavailable`.

none.meaning: Executions with no failure. Constraint: min 0.

capsule.meaning: Failures of the CC. Constraint: min 0.

input.meaning: Failures caused by the input. Constraint: min 0.

infrastructure.meaning: Failures of the platform. Reported, not counted against the pass rate. Constraint: min 0.

scientific.meaning: Valid scientific negatives. Reported, not counted against the pass rate. Constraint: min 0.

executed.meaning: Times the check ran. Constraint: min 0.

passed.meaning: Times it passed. Constraint: min 0, at most `executed`.

pass_rate.meaning: `passed` divided by `executed`. Constraint: min 0, max 1. Null when `executed` is 0.

reason.meaning: Failure reason code. Constraint: 1 to 200 characters.

observation_id.meaning: The Capsule Run Record exported. Constraint: the `id` of one line of the exported records file.

run_id.meaning: Run of the execution. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

node_id.meaning: Node of the execution. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$`.

attempt_id.meaning: Attempt of the execution. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

failure_class.meaning: Copied from the record, so a consumer can filter without opening it. Constraint: enum `capsule`, `input`, `infrastructure`, `scientific`, `none`.

call_folder.meaning: Copy of the per-call folder. Constraint: a relative path inside the export folder, ending in `/`, a prefix of at least one `files` path.

label.meaning: Whether a consumer may use the execution for development or must set it aside. Constraint: enum `development`, `held_out`. Fixed by the rule below.

sha256.meaning: File digest. Constraint: digest of the exact bytes.

node_id.meaning: Node of the run plan, or `intention_compiler` or `planner` before the plan exists

interfaces.name: qualified-intake

resource_refs.meaning: Qualified uploaded assets, such as baseline code or a dataset snapshot. Each equals the `content_sha256` of one `upload_refs` record. Constraint: at most 64 items, unique.

upload_refs.meaning: The uploads this intake used. Intake qualifies only uploaded files, so every entry of `source_refs` and `resource_refs` traces to one of them. Empty when the user uploaded nothing. Constraint: at most 64 items, unique, each a client-upload record with `status` `uploaded`.

rejected_inputs.meaning: Items the user offered that intake rejected or skipped. A rejected item never appears in `resource_refs` or `source_refs`. Constraint: at most 64 items, each names the item and the reason.

user_id.meaning: Authenticated product account that submitted the request. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

profile_ref.meaning: Profile the run executes under. Constraint: the protected local execution profile.

workspace_ref.meaning: Workspace the run may write to. Constraint: the authorized run workspace.

input_directory_ref.meaning: Configured input directory, including an empty authorized default directory. Constraint: the qualified input directory record.

prior_plan_outcome_ref.meaning: Set only on an Intention Compiler attempt started by a `plan_infeasible` [plan outcome](run-plan.md#plan-outcome). Absent or null on a first attempt. Constraint: null, or a plan outcome with `outcome` `plan_infeasible` and `next_stage` `intention_compiler`.

interfaces.name: resource-snapshot

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

interfaces.failure: Unavailable mandatory data blocks; mutable locator alone is not a reproducible identity.

interfaces.name: environment-lock
interfaces.failure: Reject an unpinned requirement line, a duplicate package ref, an unavailable package, an incompatible platform or altered lock bytes. No dynamic resolution.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this lock. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

platform.meaning: Exact supported environment, for example interpreter, version and operating system family. Constraint: 1 to 200 characters.

requirements_ref.meaning: Complete pinned declaration of direct and transitive packages. A file with only comments means no third-party package. Constraint: resolves to UTF-8 text. Every non-empty line that is not a `#` comment has the form `name==version`.

package_refs.meaning: Reviewed immutable package bytes the provisioner installs from. Empty when the requirements file pins nothing. Constraint: at most 500 items, unique.

approval_ref.meaning: Record that a human or protected policy approved this lock. Constraint: the protected preparation decision.

interfaces.name: bound-check-plan
interfaces.failure: Reject duplicate IDs, a scope that disagrees with the contract, a missing bundle or profile association or a mutable runner identity. The attempt does not start.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `2.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this plan. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

contract_ref.meaning: Exact contract the checks apply to. Constraint: a Subnode Execution Contract (subnode scope), the Node Execution Contract (node scope), or the plan source before freeze (plan gate).

input_refs.meaning: Exact bound inputs. Constraint: equals the `input_refs` of the contract when the contract is a node or subnode contract.

profile_ref.meaning: Independently owned profile the criteria come from. Constraint: the pinned checking profile or node finalization profile. At a static plan gate, which has no verifier, the static template.

policy_ref.meaning: Policy whose checks apply. Constraint: the frozen policy of the run or plan.

mandatory_deterministic.meaning: Check IDs that must each appear once in the deterministic result: every blocking check of the pinned bundle, plus contract, profile and policy checks, plus adopted `extra_check_ids`. Constraint: 1 to 64 items, unique, each pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`.

mandatory_semantic.meaning: Criterion IDs every verifier assessment must cover once. Empty for a static plan gate, where no verifier runs. Constraint: 0 to 32 items, unique, each pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`.

runner_refs.meaning: Pinned check implementations and the exact check bundle records they come from. Constraint: 1 to 16 items.

node_contract_ref.meaning: Owning Node Execution Contract, or the plan source before freeze. Constraint: equals `contract_ref` at node scope and at the plan gate. At subnode scope, the parent named by the subnode contract.

subnode_id.meaning: Work subnode the plan checks. Null for node scope and the plan gate. Constraint: null exactly when `contract_ref` equals `node_contract_ref`. Otherwise the subnode contract's `subnode_id`.

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

subnode_id.meaning: Subject/producing subnode; null for node aggregate records

interfaces.name: invocation-observation

consumers: record export (RSI workbench, platform benchmark runner)
interfaces.failure: An identity or CC triple that differs from the contract and declaration, an inconsistent measurement status, a route_id that contradicts model use, a body_files_sha256 that does not recompute, or a decision_source that contradicts route_id is rejected and the gate halts. A failure_class that contradicts the outcome keeps the gate host from appending the completed record and does not affect the run. Missing mandatory observations block release. Optional telemetry stays unavailable with a reason. Synthetic illustrations cannot certify runtime work.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 3.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `3.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this observation. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

run_id.meaning: Run the invocation belongs to. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`, equals the contract's `run_id`.

attempt_id.meaning: Node attempt the invocation belongs to. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`, equals the contract's `attempt_id`.

node_id.meaning: Node the invocation belongs to. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$`, equals the contract's `node_id`.

subnode_id.meaning: Subnode that ran. Constraint: equals the contract's `subnode_id`. Null only for a node aggregate record.

cc_name.meaning: CC that ran. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`, equals the bound declaration `identity.name`.

cc_version.meaning: Exact admitted version that ran. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$`, equals the bound declaration `identity.version_label`.

declaration_sha256.meaning: Exact declaration bytes. The RSI workbench and the benchmark runner join on the triple `cc_name`, `cc_version`, `declaration_sha256`. Constraint: equals the digest of the bound `declaration_ref`.

route_id.meaning: The [route record](model-routing-contract.md#route-record) of the invocation. Joins the observation to the model chosen. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$`. Null when the CC does not inject the audited model bridge, or when it made no model call request.

measurement_status.meaning: Whether the time, call and outcome values were measured. Constraint: enum `observed`, `unavailable`.

contract_ref.meaning: Exact contract. Constraint: the Subnode Execution Contract the CC ran under.

binding_id.meaning: Binding that ran. Constraint: equals the contract's binding `id`.

input_refs.meaning: Exact supplied inputs. A verifier receives exactly the declaration and the one output. Constraint: equals the contract's `input_refs`.

output_refs.meaning: Captured candidate outputs. Empty when nothing was written. Constraint: at most 16.

model_identity.meaning: Requested and effective model, and how the effective one was known.

started_at.meaning: Observed start. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. Non-null when `measurement_status` is `observed`.

ended_at.meaning: Observed end. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, not before `started_at`. Null while uncertain.

outcome.meaning: How the invocation ended. Constraint: enum below.

effects.meaning: Observed effects and tools used. Empty means none observed. Constraint: at most 32.

duration_s.meaning: Observed elapsed time. Constraint: min 0. Non-null when `measurement_status` is `observed`.

model_calls.meaning: Observed model calls of the CC. Constraint: min 0. Non-null when `measurement_status` is `observed`.

trace_refs.meaning: Raw evidence files of the per-call folder: prompt, capsule files, trace, model-call records, workspace copy, gate, verifier and human files ([layout](derived-records.md#records-folder-layout)). Constraint: at most 64.

unavailable_reasons.meaning: Why a value is missing. Constraint: non-empty when `measurement_status` is `unavailable`.

observed_runtime.meaning: Whether a real execution was observed. Constraint: false only in synthetic teaching examples.

usage.meaning: Token and cost telemetry, with explicit nulls and reasons. Constraint: null is never zero.

node_contract_ref.meaning: Owning Node Execution Contract. Constraint: equals the contract's `node_contract_ref`.

body_files_sha256.meaning: Exact CC files that ran. With `declaration_sha256` it names the CC version without opening the library. Constraint: SHA-256 of a UTF-8 text with one line per entry of the bound declaration `identity.body`, sorted by `path` in byte order: the path, a tab, the entry `sha256`, a line feed.

decision_source.meaning: Who chose the model. Copied from the [route record](model-routing-contract.md#route-record), so a reader tells a router choice from the fixed Codex route without a join. Constraint: enum `router`, `codex_router_disabled`, `codex_router_failed`. Null exactly when `route_id` is null. Equals the `decision_source` of the route record.

failure_class.meaning: Whose problem a failure was, by the [failure class rules](derived-records.md#failure-class-rules). A model never sets it. Constraint: enum `capsule`, `input`, `infrastructure`, `scientific`, `none`. Null only in the runner's file, before the gate host sets it.

failure_reason_code.meaning: The reason the CC reported at the stop. A declared `guarantees.failure_modes` code, or another string when the failure is undeclared. Constraint: 1 to 64 characters. Null unless the CC ended without an output and reported a reason.

error_fingerprint.meaning: SHA-256 of the error text with volatile details removed, so the same error groups across runs. Constraint: null when no error text exists.

check_result_refs.meaning: Deterministic check results of the gate for this invocation's outputs. Constraint: at most 64. Empty in the runner's file.

verifier_assessment_ref.meaning: Verifier assessment of this invocation's output. Constraint: null in the runner's file, and when no verifier ran.

human_answer_ref.meaning: The question shown, the answer given and any edit the person made. Constraint: null unless a person was asked.

interfaces.name: accepted-output

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

contract_ref.meaning: Exact checked node or subnode execution contract; scope is explicit

subnode_id.meaning: Subject/producing subnode; null for node aggregate records

interfaces.name: run-bundle
interfaces.failure: Pins that differ from the run plan, an inconsistent router pin, fault ids outside an evaluation profile, or gate and dispatch entries that differ from the stored records refuse the export. Incomplete export cannot claim completion. A derived bundle never replaces durable state.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this bundle. A re-export gets a new ID. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

run_id.meaning: Run the bundle describes. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

exported_at.meaning: When the builder wrote the bundle. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

status.meaning: Run state at export. `partial` is a finished run in which a node failed and its dependents were skipped ([D49](../method/decisions.md#d49)). Constraint: enum `in_progress`, `completed`, `partial`, `halted`, `paused`.

plan_source.meaning: Plan source of the run. Constraint: enum `static`, `planned`. Null before a run plan is frozen.

run_plan_ref.meaning: Plan every pin was resolved against. Constraint: the frozen run plan. Null before freeze.

configuration_ref.meaning: Requested and effective settings. Constraint: the frozen run configuration.

evaluation_profile_id.meaning: Approved [evaluation profile](#evaluation-profile) the app ran under. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`. Null in a product profile.

pins.meaning: Versions the benchmark runner compares with campaign pins. Constraint: see the type below.

effective_seed.meaning: Seed the run actually used. Constraint: min 0. Null when the system did not report one.

artifact_refs.meaning: Candidate and accepted artifacts. The files are the `inputs/` and `outputs/` files of the per-call folders and the `run-end/` files ([layout](derived-records.md#records-folder-layout)). Constraint: at most 500.

decision_refs.meaning: Gate decisions of the run. Constraint: at most 200, unique, equal to the set of `gate_decisions[].decision_ref`.

gate_decisions.meaning: Gate outcome summary, so the runner needs not open each decision. Constraint: at most 200. One entry per per-output decision and one per node-scope decision.

node_dispatches.meaning: When each node attempt ran and how it ended. Constraint: at most 64. One entry per node attempt, in dispatch order.

observation_refs.meaning: Invocation observations of the run. Constraint: at most 500.

model_call_refs.meaning: Model-call records of the run. Constraint: at most 2000.

route_record_refs.meaning: Route records of the run, one per routed invocation. Constraint: at most 2000.

fault_ids.meaning: Faults the evaluation profile injected. Constraint: each pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`. Empty when `evaluation_profile_id` is null.

missing_evidence.meaning: Items not produced or unavailable, with reasons. Constraint: at most 100.

redactions.meaning: What this audience does not see, and why. Constraint: at most 100.

interfaces.name: client-readiness
interfaces.failure: Wrong target or version, a mandatory unavailable prerequisite, pins that disagree with the build identity or fault injection without an evaluation profile blocks submission. Liveness alone is insufficient.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this readiness report. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

client_contract_version.meaning: Client contract version the app serves. Constraint: pattern `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`.

instance_id.meaning: Target instance identity. Constraint: 1 to 120 characters.

build_id.meaning: Application build identity. Constraint: 1 to 120 characters.

operations.meaning: Operations the app accepts now. Constraint: 1 to 32 items, unique, each from the client operation names, for example `submit`, `status`, `retrieve`, `cancel`.

prerequisites.meaning: Storage, auth, model and isolation state, each with a reason. Constraint: at most 32.

ready.meaning: Whether a submission can start. Constraint: true only when every mandatory prerequisite has status `ready`.

evaluation_profile.meaning: `profile_id` of the evaluation profile the launcher started the app with. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`. Null in every product profile.

fault_injection.meaning: Whether the app accepts a `fault_id` on submit. Constraint: true only when `evaluation_profile` is not null and that profile allows E4.

pins.meaning: Versions a run submitted now would use. The [RunPins](#run-bundle) type is shared with the run bundle. Constraint: `app_build` equals `build_id`, `client_contract_version` equals the field above.

interfaces.name: client-submission
interfaces.failure: A fault without a profile and evaluation link, or a profile that differs from readiness, is rejected with a client-error. Reconcile uncertain delivery by request identity before resubmission. Do not replay capsule work.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this submission record. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

client_request_id.meaning: Idempotent submission identity used to reconcile uncertain delivery. Constraint: pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$`, unique per submission attempt.

workspace_id.meaning: Scope of the run. Constraint: an authorized workspace.

account_id.meaning: Who submits. Constraint: the authenticated actor.

intake_ref.meaning: Qualified request and resources. Constraint: a qualified intake.

configuration_ref.meaning: The operator's approved `config.yaml` snapshot, approved by the operator, never by a client. A client cannot set `cc.router.*` or any other operator setting. Constraint: an approved run configuration.

plan_source.meaning: Chooses the plan before the run: `static` for the static template, `planned` for the Planner node (D39). The binder copies it into the run plan. Nothing else selects it. Constraint: enum `static`, `planned`. Default `static`. Under an evaluation profile it equals that profile's `plan_source`.

interaction_mode.meaning: Whether a person is present to answer intake clarification questions. A web UI submission defaults to `interactive`. A CLI or sidecar submission defaults to `headless`. The control plane freezes it in the run configuration. It changes nothing after intake: no run waits for a person ([D50](../method/decisions.md#d50)). Constraint: enum `interactive`, `headless`.

evaluation.meaning: Campaign identities the app copies into the run bundle. Constraint: absent or null for product use. Set only by the platform benchmark runner.

profile_id.meaning: Evaluation profile the client expects. The app refuses a mismatch. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`, equals readiness `evaluation_profile`.

fault_id.meaning: Fault from the campaign fault plan to inject in this run. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`. Non-null only when `profile_id` is set and readiness `fault_injection` is true.

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

node_statuses.meaning: One entry per node of the plan, with its PRD lifecycle name

interfaces.failure: Disconnection does not cancel; malformed or stale status is unavailable, not accepted completion.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

interfaces.failure: No direct database/volume access; path escape or forbidden audience is rejected.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

preserved_effects.meaning: Known effects that cannot be undone

interfaces.name: client-upload

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable upload ID. The delete operation names it. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

user_id.meaning: Authenticated user who uploaded the file. Only that user lists or deletes it. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

scope_id.meaning: The run or project the file belongs to. It names the folder under the kind folder. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$`.

kind.meaning: Which input folder holds the file. Constraint: enum `docs`, `repo`, `datasets`.

resource_type.meaning: The PRD resource type that intake registers. Constraint: enum `reference_document`, `project_asset`, `validation_data`. Follows `kind`.

filename.meaning: File name as stored. It holds no path separator. Constraint: pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$`.

size_bytes.meaning: Size of the stored bytes. Constraint: min 0.

stored_path.meaning: Where the file sits in the app container volume. Constraint: equals `workspace/input/<kind>/<scope_id>/<filename>`.

content_sha256.meaning: Identity of the uploaded bytes. Kept after deletion. Constraint: SHA-256 of the stored bytes.

text_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text extracted from the document. Constraint: non-null exactly when `kind` is `docs`.

status.meaning: Whether the bytes are still stored. Constraint: enum `uploaded`, `deleted`.

uploaded_at.meaning: Time the file was stored. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

deleted_at.meaning: Time the bytes were removed. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. Non-null exactly when `status` is `deleted`.

interfaces.failure: A wrong type, an unreadable document, an unsafe archive entry or a failed write is refused with a client-error and nothing is stored. A delete is refused while a run that uses the upload is not finished.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

interfaces.failure: Never include credentials/hidden fixtures or suggest implicit work retry.

interfaces.name: rsi-target-profile

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this target profile. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

parent_ref.meaning: Eligible exact sandbox parent code. Constraint: one body file of the parent declaration. Its digest is in `identity.body`.

parent_declaration_ref.meaning: Declaration whose `evolution.may_change` bounds `mutable_paths`. Constraint: the parent declaration bytes. Its `evolution.rsi` is `propose`.

frozen_contract_ref.meaning: Unchanged interface. Constraint: the interface contract bytes the child keeps.

required_test_refs.meaning: Mandatory parent tests. The child must pass all of them. Constraint: 1 to 16 items.

mutable_paths.meaning: The only body paths the proposer may change. Constraint: 1 to 16 unique paths. Each is covered by a `files:` glob in the parent `evolution.may_change` (check `profile_within_may_change`).

protected_refs.meaning: Immutable dependency and referee closure. Constraint: 1 to 32 items. None is a mutable path.

splits.meaning: Disjoint partition identities. Constraint: four distinct identities.

scoring.meaning: Passed-tests-first scoring with a timing tie rule. Constraint: `primary` is `passed_test_count`, `secondary` is `paired_time_at_equal_counts`, `warmup_batches` is 5, `paired_rounds` is 7.

calibration_ref.meaning: Measured headroom and timing noise. Constraint: a calibration record with planted good and bad children.

session_query_limit.meaning: Hidden-loop queries one session may spend. Constraint: exactly 30.

lifetime_query_limit.meaning: Hidden-loop queries over the lifetime of the registered loop set. Constraint: exactly 90.

limits.meaning: Frozen bounds for every child run. Constraint: positive values.

scoring_adapter_ref.meaning: Frozen independent scoring adapter. Constraint: the frozen scoring adapter bytes.

improver_ref.meaning: Fixed proposer policy and implementation. Constraint: the fixed proposer policy and implementation bytes.

configuration_ref.meaning: Frozen model, host and runtime settings, the same for parent and child. Constraint: the frozen configuration bytes.

interfaces.failure: No calibrated headroom, overlapping splits, a mutable path outside the parent `evolution.may_change`, or a mutable referee blocks the session. Never edit the profile in response to candidate results.

interfaces.name: rsi-attempt

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this attempt record. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

session_id.meaning: Session this attempt belongs to. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`, equals the session `session_id`.

sequence.meaning: Position of the attempt in the session, counted from 1. Constraint: 1 to 20.

previous_ref.meaning: Previous attempt in the hash chain. Constraint: null exactly when `sequence` is 1. Otherwise the attempt with `sequence` minus 1.

target_ref.meaning: Frozen target profile. Constraint: equals the session `target_profile_ref`.

parent_ref.meaning: The same eligible parent on every attempt. Constraint: equals the target profile `parent_ref`.

child_ref.meaning: Exact proposed child. Constraint: the exact proposed child body. Differs from `parent_ref`.

diff_ref.meaning: Allowed implementation change. Constraint: a diff that touches only mutable paths.

rationale.meaning: The proposer explanation. It is not proof and is never read as evidence. Constraint: 1 to 2000 characters.

visible_evidence_refs.meaning: Visible test results the proposer saw. Constraint: 0 to 32 items.

queries_used.meaning: Hidden-loop queries spent so far, as counted by the custodian. Constraint: 0 to 30.

violations.meaning: Violations the mutation check observed. Constraint: 0 to 50 items.

stop_reason.meaning: Why the session ended at this attempt, or null. Constraint: non-null when `violations` is not empty or the session stops here.

configuration_ref.meaning: Same frozen target context. Constraint: equals the target profile `configuration_ref`.

observation_refs.meaning: Protected model, time and call traces. Constraint: 0 to 64 items.

time_s.meaning: Observed elapsed session time, or unavailable. Constraint: min 0. Null when not observed.

model_calls.meaning: Observed proposal model calls, or unavailable. Constraint: min 0. Null when not observed.

unavailable_reasons.meaning: Why telemetry is missing. Missing telemetry is never reported as zero. Constraint: 0 to 10 items. Non-empty when `time_s` or `model_calls` is null.

hash_profile_ref.meaning: Pinned serialization and hash profile. Constraint: equals the session `hash_profile_ref`.

chain_root_ref.meaning: Protected genesis record. The first attempt never refers to itself. Constraint: equals the session `chain_root_ref`.

interfaces.failure: A broken chain or lineage, an unauthorized mutation or a security violation halts the session and keeps the evidence. A clearance is needed before a new session.

interfaces.name: rsi-loop-feedback

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this loop feedback record. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

passed.meaning: Aggregate hidden-loop passed count. Constraint: min 0, at most `total`.

queries_left.meaning: Hidden-loop queries still allowed in the session. Constraint: 0 to 30.

interfaces.failure: Counts only. No case IDs, content, timing, expected answers or final feedback enter the proposal context. A record with extra fields is refused.

interfaces.name: rsi-referee-evidence

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this referee evidence record. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

attempt_ref.meaning: Exact attempt the referee assessed. Constraint: an `rsi-attempt` record.
