template_name.meaning: Name of the fixed path, for example `m1_research_path`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$.

plan_source.meaning: Marks a hand-authored plan. Constraint: exactly static.

nodes.meaning: The fixed nodes. Same node shape as a plan proposal. Constraint: 1 to 12 nodes.

coverage.meaning: Self-review map from each Brief item to the nodes that cover it. An entry names one Brief item, or uses a `selector` for all items of one kind, because a template is written before any Brief exists. It is the exact inverse of the node tags after the binder expands the selectors. Constraint: 1 to 60 entries.

limits.meaning: Aggregate ceiling for the whole plan. Constraint: same rule as a plan proposal.

interfaces.failure: Reject before dispatch for a failed binder check. A template grants no authority.

interfaces.name: library-snapshot

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this snapshot. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

captured_at.meaning: When the library captured the snapshot. Constraint: UTC time, pattern YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

entries.meaning: Eligible CC versions. Active library changes after capture never alter this list. Constraint: 1 to 200 entries; the pair (cc_name, cc_version) is unique.

interfaces.failure: An entry with a null check pin is unusable. The binder rejects any node that names it.

interfaces.name: resource-inventory

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this snapshot. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

resources.meaning: Resources supplied by the user or observed on the host. Constraint: 0 to 100 items; resource_key unique.

interfaces.failure: A missing resource makes every node that needs it infeasible. The binder rejects the plan.

interfaces.name: plan-policy

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this policy. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

max_nodes.meaning: Most nodes a plan may hold. Constraint: 1 to 12.

allowed_effect_classes.meaning: Effect classes a node CC may have. M1 excludes `irreversible`. Constraint: 1 to 5 values from the effect class enum.

allow_network.meaning: When false, no node may use a CC whose `network_mode` is not `none`.

required_stages.meaning: CCs that every plan holds, static or planned. The binder enforces this list in check `delivery_leaf_coverage`. Constraint: 0 to 12 CC names, unique, each in the library. Each named CC runs in exactly one node of the plan.

aggregate_limits.meaning: Ceiling for the whole plan. Time and calls add across nodes. Memory is the largest node value because M1 runs nodes one at a time. Constraint: positive; model_calls may be 0.

max_attempts_per_node.meaning: Ceiling for `max_attempts` of any node. Constraint: 1 to 3.

interfaces.failure: A plan outside the policy is rejected. The Planner cannot change the policy.

interfaces.name: run-plan

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this frozen plan. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

plan_source.meaning: `static` when built from a static template. `planned` when built from a Planner proposal. Both use this same type. Constraint: enum.

brief_ref.meaning: Brief the plan answers. Constraint: the accepted Brief.

library_snapshot_ref.meaning: Snapshot every CC pin was resolved against. Constraint: the pinned snapshot.

resource_inventory_ref.meaning: Resources the feasibility check used. Constraint: the pinned snapshot.

policy_ref.meaning: Plan policy the checks used. Constraint: the pinned policy.

configuration_ref.meaning: Effective run configuration. Constraint: the frozen run configuration.

source_ref.meaning: The unmodified source the binder started from. Constraint: a static template when plan_source is static, a plan proposal when plan_source is planned.

acceptance_ref.meaning: Committed acceptance of the bound plan. Dispatch cannot start without it. Constraint: when plan_source is planned, a gate decision with action advance. When plan_source is static, a deterministic check result whose checks all PASS on the template (no verifier runs).

nodes.meaning: Bound nodes with resolved accepted refs and copied check pins. Constraint: 1 to 12 nodes.

coverage.meaning: The coverage map after the binder expanded every selector of a static template against the accepted Brief. Concrete Brief IDs only. It is the exact inverse of the node tags. Constraint: 1 to 60 entries; one entry per mandatory requirement and per deliverable of the Brief.

topological_order.meaning: Dispatch order computed by the binder. M1 runs nodes one at a time in this order. Constraint: each node ID once; every node after all its predecessors.

limits.meaning: Aggregate ceiling for the whole plan. Constraint: same rule as a plan proposal.

frozen.meaning: Marks the plan immutable. After freeze there is no replan, substitution or pin change. Constraint: must be true.

interfaces.failure: A missing acceptance record, an unresolved accepted ref or a missing pin blocks dispatch. Nothing in a frozen run plan may change.

interfaces.name: dispatch-record

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 2.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this record. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

run_id.meaning: Run this record belongs to. The host assigns it at intake and every run-state record (contracts, check plans, gate decisions, dispatch records) carries it. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$.

attempt_id.meaning: Identity of this node attempt. The scheduler builds it as <node_id>-a<attempt>, for example evaluation-a1. The node contract, check plans and gate decisions of the attempt carry it. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$ and equal to <node_id>-a<attempt>.

phase.meaning: Whether the node ran before or after the run plan was frozen. pre_plan: the Intention Compiler node and the Planner node. planned: every node of the run plan. Constraint: enum.

run_plan_ref.meaning: Plan the dispatch belongs to. Constraint: the frozen run plan of this run. Null only when phase is pre_plan.

node_id.meaning: Node dispatched. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$. When phase is planned, a node of the run plan. When phase is pre_plan, intention_compiler or planner.

cc.meaning: CC version that ran. Constraint: equal to the run plan node cc, or the Planner library entry pin for node planner. Null only for node intention_compiler, which has two work CCs pinned in its node contract.

node_contract_ref.meaning: The Node Execution Contract (node scope) that the scheduler built for this attempt from the run plan node. Constraint: its run_id, node_id and attempt_id equal this record.

bound_input_refs.meaning: Exact accepted artifacts passed in. Constraint: one per node input that was bound; names unique; at most 16.

check_pins.meaning: Check bundle and profile that applied. Constraint: equal to the run plan node check_pins. Null exactly when cc is null.

check_plan_ref.meaning: Bound check plan of the node scope, built for this attempt. Constraint: a bound check plan whose node_contract_ref equals node_contract_ref.

attempt.meaning: Attempt number. A new attempt is a new record. Constraint: 1 to the node max_attempts (1 in M1).

started_at.meaning: Dispatch start time. Constraint: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

ended_at.meaning: End time. Constraint: null only for outcome interrupted; otherwise UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

outcome.meaning: How the attempt ended. `accepted`: the gate accepted the outputs. `rejected`: a blocking check or criterion failed, so the node halted and its candidate and evidence are kept. `halted`: protected stop. `failed`: execution or infrastructure error. `budget_exhausted`: a limit was hit. `interrupted`: the process ended before a decision. Constraint: enum.

gate_decision_ref.meaning: The node-scope gate decision for this attempt. Constraint: scope_kind node. Null only for outcomes failed, budget_exhausted and interrupted.

output_gate_decision_refs.meaning: The subnode-scope gate decisions that the node-scope decision aggregates, one for each output reviewed (its internal_decision_refs). Constraint: empty exactly when gate_decision_ref is null. At most 16.

output_refs.meaning: Accepted outputs. Rejected output stays in evidence, not here. Constraint: non-empty only for outcome accepted; at most 16.

elapsed_s.meaning: Observed wall time in seconds. Constraint: null or at least 0.

model_calls_used.meaning: Observed model calls, null when unobserved. Constraint: null or at least 0.

interfaces.failure: A record that names a node, pin or input not in the run plan is rejected and the dispatch is blocked. Records are append-only.

interfaces.name: search-scope
interfaces.producer: Protected binder (from run configuration, resource inventory and Planner topic hints)

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

connectors.meaning: Permitted connectors. Each from the connector enum, no duplicates. Anything not listed is forbidden

max_queries.meaning: Most queries Search may write and run

max_hits_per_query.meaning: Most sources one external connector may contribute per query

local_document_refs.meaning: User local documents Search may read. Non-empty when local_documents is permitted

topic_hints.meaning: Optional topic phrases from the Planner. Search may use them when it writes queries. Empty when plan_source is static. 0 to 5 items, each 3 to 100 characters, no duplicates

interfaces.failure: A scope that fails its structure check blocks the Search dispatch. Search writes its own queries inside these bounds.

interfaces.name: candidate-set

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

scope_ref.meaning: Bound search_scope whose bounds Search ran under

queries.meaning: The queries Search itself wrote and ran, in run order. 1 to max_queries items, each 3 to 200 characters, no duplicates. Every citation query is one of them

connector_outcomes.meaning: One row per permitted connector, including failures

ideas.meaning: One to three grounded ideas, each citing at least one citation

interfaces.failure: Wrong idea count, uncited idea, unresolved citation, excerpt mismatch or queries outside the scope bounds reject. No evidence from any connector halts. An unavailable connector is recorded, never filled with an invented hit.

interfaces.name: screening-rubric
interfaces.producer: CC owner (pinned in the Screening declaration)

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

tie_rule.meaning: Equal totals rank the lower idea_id first

forbidden_dependencies.meaning: Dependencies that make an idea ineligible

interfaces.failure: A rubric hash that differs from the pin halts Screening. RSI never changes the rubric.

interfaces.name: screening-result

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

scores.meaning: Exactly one row per candidate idea

ranking.meaning: Selected and eligible ideas by total descending then idea_id ascending

interfaces.failure: Missing, duplicate or out-of-range scores, wrong totals or order reject. No eligible idea halts with no_eligible_idea.

interfaces.name: opportunity-card

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

idea_id.meaning: Selected idea. Equals screening_result.selected_idea_id and exists in the candidate set

summary.meaning: Purpose of the card: what is tested and why

scores.meaning: Original scores of the selected idea, unchanged

constraints.meaning: Verbatim text of every Brief constraint and mandatory requirement

other_dispositions.meaning: One row per non-selected candidate idea

interfaces.failure: A selected idea outside the candidate set, a mismatch with the screening result, a lost constraint or a missing disposition rejects.

interfaces.name: check-bundle

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

checks.meaning: Deterministic checks. Must include a blocking <port>_schema check per output port

interfaces.failure: Missing blocking schema check per output port, or unpinned bundle on an admitted CC version, rejects admission and binding

interfaces.name: checking-profile

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

criteria.meaning: Must include the three generic criteria, blocking

interfaces.failure: Any criterion with answerable_from other than declaration_and_output, or a missing generic criterion, rejects admission

interfaces.name: review-context

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

contract_ref.meaning: Exact checked node or subnode execution contract; scope is explicit

subnode_id.meaning: Subject/producing subnode; null for node aggregate records

interfaces.failure: Host-only audit record. It is never part of the verifier model payload. A missing or mismatched manifest blocks the gate.

interfaces.name: gate-decision-index
interfaces.producer: Scheduler (host record built from accepted dispatch records)

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

run_plan_ref.meaning: The frozen run plan of this run

entries.meaning: One entry per node whose node-scope gate advanced before Delivery started, in run plan topological order. Node IDs unique, so the index holds one decision per node

interfaces.failure: A missing or unresolved entry blocks Delivery dispatch. Delivery never builds the index itself.

interfaces.name: plan-outcome

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this record

outcome.meaning: The recorded halt outcome. plan_infeasible is the only value in M1

trigger.meaning: What made the plan infeasible. proposal_rejected: a binder or proposal check rejected the proposal or template. plan_rejected: with plan_source planned, the plan gate did not advance. planner_reported_infeasible: the Planner replied INFEASIBLE. Constraint: enum.

brief_ref.meaning: The accepted Brief the plan was meant to answer. It is carried to the next Intention Compiler attempt

source_ref.meaning: The rejected plan proposal or static template. Null only when the Planner reported infeasibility and produced no graph

check_result_ref.meaning: The deterministic check result that carries the failing check. Constraint: null only when trigger is planner_reported_infeasible, because no check ran. Never null when a check ran.

gate_decision_ref.meaning: The plan gate decision. Constraint: non-null only when trigger is plan_rejected, which happens only when plan_source is planned. Null otherwise.

reasons.meaning: Why the plan is infeasible. Carried to the next attempt. 1 to 20 items

attempt_depth.meaning: Position of this plan attempt in the chain of linked Intention Compiler attempts for one request. The first plan attempt is 1. M1 default limit is 2

next_stage.meaning: Where the host sends the request next

linked_attempt_id.meaning: ID of the new Intention Compiler attempt the host started from this outcome. Null when attempt_depth has reached the limit or the rejected source is a static template, and the host halts and writes an escalation record

interfaces.failure: A plan_infeasible outcome without reasons, or one that lets the same run continue, is invalid. The run halts and nothing is repaired inside it.

interfaces.name: evaluation-profile
interfaces.producer: protected configuration owner, approved by the benchmark owner
interfaces.failure: An inconsistent router pin, an evaluation-only entry point or candidate pin without invalid_for_product, or a duplicate entry point stops the launcher. A run whose library snapshot or candidate pin does not match halts before dispatch.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this record. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

profile_id.meaning: Name clients see in readiness `evaluation_profile` and send as `profile_id`. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

plan_source.meaning: The `plan_source` every run under this profile must request. A submission whose `plan_source` differs is rejected (`plan_source_matches_profile`). The profile mirrors the run setting and adds no other selector. Constraint: enum `static`, `planned`.

router_enabled.meaning: Whether the API router is on. Constraint: becomes `cc.router.enabled`.

router_version.meaning: Router version the comparison pins. Constraint: null exactly when `router_enabled` is false.

model_route.meaning: Route kept apart from the model identifier. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$`. The fixed Codex route ID when `router_enabled` is false.

library_snapshot_sha256.meaning: Library state under test. The binder refuses a run whose snapshot differs. Constraint: digest of the library snapshot every run must capture.

candidate_pins.meaning: CC versions that replace the active version of the same `cc_name` for this profile. Each must be an admitted entry of the pinned snapshot. Constraint: at most 8, `cc_name` unique. Empty unless comparing an RSI child.

verifier_cc_ref.meaning: Verifier version every verifier subnode must bind. Constraint: the Verifier CC declaration bytes.

invalid_for_product.meaning: Marks every run and bundle of this profile as unusable as product output or RSI material. Constraint: true when `allowed_entry_points` holds E2, E3, E4 or E5, or `candidate_pins` is not empty.

allowed_entry_points.meaning: Entry points the app exposes under this profile. E6 is runner-side and never listed. Constraint: 1 to 5 items, unique, each enum `E1`, `E2`, `E3`, `E4`, `E5`.

interfaces.name: empirical-results
interfaces.failure: A sequence gap, duplicate or misorder, a non-finite value or differing metric keys rejects the file and the Benchmark node halts. Values are never filled or smoothed.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Artifact identity. Constraint: exactly `empirical_results`.

runs.meaning: One entry per receipt run. Constraint: min 2. `sequence` is 1..N with no gap or duplicate, in ascending order.

interfaces.name: rsi-session
interfaces.producer: RSI controller, started by a human
interfaces.failure: A limit above its default, a qualification value weaker than the frozen rule, or pins that differ from the genesis or the target profile stop the session before attempt 1. The result outcome is BLOCKED.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this frozen session record. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

session_id.meaning: Session that every attempt, query and result names. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

target_profile_ref.meaning: Frozen target: parent, mutable paths, tests, splits and scoring. Constraint: an `rsi-target-profile` record.

parent.meaning: Exact parent version. The final comparison always runs against it. Constraint: an admitted library version. `declaration_sha256` equals `parent_declaration_ref.sha256`.

parent_declaration_ref.meaning: Declaration the child must keep, outside the pointers RSI may write. Constraint: the parent declaration bytes. Equals the target profile `parent_declaration_ref`.

improver_ref.meaning: Fixed proposer policy and implementation. Constraint: equals the target profile `improver_ref`.

scoring_adapter_ref.meaning: Frozen scoring adapter the referee runs. Constraint: equals the target profile `scoring_adapter_ref`.

configuration_ref.meaning: Frozen model, host and runtime settings, the same for parent and child. Constraint: equals the target profile `configuration_ref`.

hash_profile_ref.meaning: How attempt records are serialized, hashed and chained. Constraint: the pinned serialization and hash profile.

chain_root_ref.meaning: Root of the attempt hash chain, fixed before attempt 1. Constraint: the protected genesis record. It pins this `session_id`, the target and the hash profile.

limits.meaning: Search budget of the session. Constraint: each value at most its default.

pass_count_repeats.meaning: Repeats per fixture for pass counts: 1 for a deterministic target, 3 for a model-backed target. Constraint: enum `1`, `3`.

qualification.meaning: Qualification values, pinned before any code is proposed. Constraint: no value weaker than the [qualification rule](../side-systems/rsi-workbench.md#qualification-rule).

started_by.meaning: Who started the session. A session never starts itself. Constraint: 1 to 120 characters, an authenticated human actor.

frozen_at.meaning: When the session record was frozen, before attempt 1. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

interfaces.name: rsi-session-result
interfaces.failure: A result whose qualification does not recompute, or whose statistics differ from the referee evidence, produces no candidate package. Outcomes other than QUALIFIED never produce one.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this session result. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

session_ref.meaning: Session this result closes. Constraint: the frozen `rsi-session` record.

outcome.meaning: Terminal outcome of the session. Constraint: enum, see below.

parent.meaning: Original parent of the final comparison. Constraint: equals the session `parent`.

child.meaning: Retained child version. Constraint: non-null for `QUALIFIED`. Null when no child was retained.

child_declaration_ref.meaning: Exact child declaration bytes. Constraint: null exactly when `child` is null. Its digest equals `child.declaration_sha256`.

attempt_refs.meaning: Every attempt of the session. Constraint: 0 to 20, in sequence order, a hash chain from the session genesis.

final_attempt_ref.meaning: Attempt that produced the finalist. Constraint: an entry of `attempt_refs`. Null when no final comparison ran.

referee_evidence_ref.meaning: Protected referee evidence of the final comparison. Constraint: non-null when a final comparison ran.

qualified_by.meaning: Which branch of the qualification rule the child met. Constraint: enum `pass_gain`, `timing_tiebreak`, `none`. `none` exactly when `outcome` is not `QUALIFIED`.

statistics.meaning: Counts and statistics the rule was applied to. Constraint: non-null when a final comparison ran.

attempts_used.meaning: Attempts the session started. Constraint: 0 to the session `limits.max_attempts`.

queries_used.meaning: Hidden-loop queries the session spent. Constraint: 0 to the session `limits.session_query_limit`. Includes the baseline query.

stop_reason.meaning: Why search stopped, in plain words. Constraint: 1 to 300 characters.

limitations.meaning: Limits of this result, for example synthetic data or unavailable telemetry. Constraint: at most 20.

recorded_at.meaning: When the controller closed the session. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

signature.meaning: Signature of the custodian over the canonical JSON bytes of this record without the `signature` field. The key is held by `rsi_custodian` and `rsi_worker` cannot read it. Constraint: 43 to 128 characters of base64url or hex.

signer_key_id.meaning: ID of the signing key. Constraint: equals `rsi.custodian_key_id` of the operator config.

interfaces.name: candidate-package
interfaces.failure: A package that fails a content check is rejected; one with an unresolved ref or a broken attempt chain is blocked. A touched path outside the profile is a security halt. No package grants standing.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this candidate package. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

target_profile_ref.meaning: Target profile that set the mutable paths. Constraint: equals the session `target_profile_ref`.

session_ref.meaning: Session that produced the child. Constraint: the frozen `rsi-session` record.

session_result_ref.meaning: Result that qualified the child. Constraint: an `rsi-session-result` with outcome `QUALIFIED`.

provenance_ref.meaning: Builder, body files and evidence of the child. Constraint: a `candidate-provenance` record whose `declaration_ref` equals `child_declaration_ref`.

parent.meaning: Parent version and its declaration digest. Constraint: equals the session `parent`. `declaration_sha256` equals `parent_declaration_ref.sha256`.

child.meaning: Child version and its declaration digest. Constraint: same `cc_name` as `parent`, a new `cc_version`. `declaration_sha256` equals `child_declaration_ref.sha256`.

parent_declaration_ref.meaning: Declaration the child is compared with. Constraint: the parent declaration bytes.

child_declaration_ref.meaning: Declaration admission stores for the child. Constraint: the child declaration bytes. Its `identity.lineage` names the parent.

diff_ref.meaning: The allowed implementation change. Constraint: equals the final attempt `diff_ref`.

referee_evidence_ref.meaning: Protected paired evidence of the final comparison. Constraint: equals the session result `referee_evidence_ref`.

mutable_paths_touched.meaning: Body paths the change touched. Constraint: 1 to 16 unique paths, each in the target profile `mutable_paths`.

created_at.meaning: When the workbench wrote the package to the inbox. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

interfaces.name: rsi-opportunity
interfaces.producer: RSI workbench controller (opportunity qualifier), after a human selects the target
interfaces.failure: A decision that does not follow from the recorded evidence refuses the record. The session does not start. START needs a reproduced implementation symptom, passing parent mandatory behavior, enough headroom and a retained diagnosis.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this opportunity decision. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

target_profile_ref.meaning: Target the opportunity concerns. Constraint: an `rsi-target-profile` record.

parent.meaning: Exact parent version the evidence was gathered on. Constraint: an admitted library version. `declaration_sha256` equals the target profile `parent_declaration_ref` digest.

trigger.meaning: How the target was chosen. M1 has no always-on scheduler. Constraint: enum `operator_selected`, `authorized_batch`.

selected_by.meaning: Who selected the target or approved the batch. Constraint: 1 to 120 characters, an authenticated human actor.

evidence_refs.meaning: Authorized observations and benchmark evidence examined, with their original references. Constraint: 1 to 32 items.

attribution.meaning: Demonstrated cause class after visible reproduction. A heuristic label or a CC self-report is never enough. Constraint: enum `implementation`, `upstream_input`, `binding_composition`, `harness`, `verifier`, `environment`, `uncertain`.

symptom_reproduced.meaning: Whether the symptom reproduced on approved visible inputs, with the exact parent and the frozen environment.

parent_mandatory_passed.meaning: Whether the parent passed its mandatory behavior on the development inputs. Development failures add headroom and never waive an obligation.

headroom.meaning: Development failure rate of the parent on approved visible inputs. Constraint: 0 to 1. Null when the symptom did not reproduce.

headroom_minimum.meaning: Smallest headroom that makes an attempt worth starting. Constraint: 0 to 1, equals the minimum the target profile declares.

diagnosis_ref.meaning: Retained structured diagnosis of the symptom: observed symptom, mechanism, alternative causes, authorized component, proposed direction and falsification checks. Constraint: non-null when `decision` is `START`.

decision.meaning: What happens next. `START` freezes a session. `NO_ATTEMPT` records why no attempt runs. `NEEDS_REVIEW` waits for a human. Constraint: enum `START`, `NO_ATTEMPT`, `NEEDS_REVIEW`.

reason.meaning: Why this decision, in plain words. Constraint: 1 to 300 characters.

decided_at.meaning: When the controller wrote the decision. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

interfaces.name: rsi-completion-report
interfaces.producer: RSI workbench report builder, after a human closes the M1 RSI acceptance run
interfaces.failure: A claim without evidence refuses the record. A blocked or incomplete requirement is reported as such and never as passed. Missing telemetry is listed under `unavailable` and never reported as zero.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this completion report. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

session_result_refs.meaning: Every session in scope, including no-gain and inconclusive ones. Constraint: 1 to 64 items, each an `rsi-session-result` record.

requirement_coverage.meaning: Status of each RSI build criterion. Constraint: 1 to 32 items, `requirement_id` unique.

executed_tests.meaning: Acceptance and security tests that ran. Constraint: 0 to 200 items, `test_id` unique.

modalities.meaning: Modalities the sessions covered. `text` appears only when the bounded headless text path ran. Constraint: 1 to 2 items, each `code` or `text`.

qualified_result_refs.meaning: Sessions that produced a qualifying child. Gains are read from them. Constraint: 0 to 64 items, each also in `session_result_refs` with outcome `QUALIFIED`.

onboarding_evidence_refs.meaning: Evidence that a second, unrelated target ran through the same engine. Constraint: 0 to 16 items.

transfer_claim.meaning: Whether the report claims improver transfer. It is a separate claim gate. Constraint: enum `none`, `supported`.

transfer_evidence_refs.meaning: Held-out transfer evidence. Constraint: 0 to 16 items. At least 1 when `transfer_claim` is `supported`.

blockers.meaning: Blocked dependencies, each with its reason. Constraint: 0 to 50 items. At least 1 when a requirement is `BLOCKED`.

uncertainties.meaning: What the evidence leaves open. Constraint: 0 to 50 items.

unavailable.meaning: Values that could not be measured, for example monetary cost. Constraint: 0 to 50 items.

containment_limitations.meaning: Residual containment limits and any discovered vulnerability. Constraint: 0 to 20 items.

compiled_by.meaning: Who or what compiled the report. Constraint: 1 to 120 characters.

recorded_at.meaning: When the report was written. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

interfaces.name: contract-conformance
interfaces.failure: A record whose counts or coverage do not recompute, that omits a declared clause, or whose identity differs from its Capsule Run Record is not written. A missing observation source is unavailable with a reason. The run is never affected.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this record. A rebuild gets a new ID. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

run_id.meaning: Run of the execution. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`, equals the record's `run_id`.

node_id.meaning: Node of the execution. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$`, equals the record's `node_id`.

attempt_id.meaning: Node attempt of the execution. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`, equals the record's `attempt_id`.

subnode_id.meaning: Subnode that ran. Constraint: equals the record's `subnode_id`.

observation_id.meaning: The Capsule Run Record this record compares. Constraint: equals the `id` of one line of the records file.

records_ref.meaning: Exact records file read. Constraint: the `records.jsonl` file that holds that line.

cc_name.meaning: CC that ran. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`, equals the record's `cc_name`.

cc_version.meaning: Exact version that ran. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$`, equals the record's `cc_version`.

declaration_ref.meaning: Exact declaration compared against. Constraint: the declaration bound to the invocation.

declaration_sha256.meaning: Join key with the record. Constraint: equals the digest of `declaration_ref` and the record's `declaration_sha256`.

built_at.meaning: When the builder wrote the record. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

items.meaning: One entry per declared clause and per undeclared behavior. Constraint: at most 200. Covers the clauses in the table below.

undeclared_count.meaning: Behavior with no declaration. Constraint: min 0, equals the number of items with status `undeclared`.

unused_count.meaning: Declarations never used. Constraint: min 0, equals the number of items with status `unused`.

coverage.meaning: Share of observed behavior that the declaration accounted for. Constraint: min 0, max 1. Null when no observed behavior exists.

evidence_refs.meaning: Tool-call logs, the workspace copy and the check results the builder read. Constraint: at most 64.

unavailable_reasons.meaning: Why an observation was not available. Constraint: at most 50. Non-empty when an item is `unavailable`.

interfaces.name: capsule-scorecard
interfaces.failure: A scorecard whose counts do not recompute from its records file, that claims release authority, or whose check rates are inconsistent is not written. An unmeasured value is null with a reason. The run is never affected.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this scorecard. A rebuild gets a new ID. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

declaration_sha256.meaning: Exact declaration scored. Constraint: equals the `declaration_sha256` of every record used.

built_at.meaning: When the builder wrote the scorecard. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

records_ref.meaning: Exact records file read. Constraint: a `records.jsonl` file.

conformance_refs.meaning: Conformance records behind `undeclared_behavior_count` and `mean_declaration_coverage`. Empty when none were built. Constraint: at most 5000. Each is a conformance record of a scored execution.

record_ids.meaning: Executions scored. Constraint: 1 to 5000 unique IDs, each the `id` of a line of the records file whose CC triple equals this scorecard's.

run_ids.meaning: Runs the executions come from. Constraint: 1 to 500 unique run IDs, equal to the set of `run_id` of the scored records.

release_authority.meaning: The scorecard grants no release authority. A gate decision never reads it. Constraint: enum `none`.

execution_count.meaning: Executions scored. Constraint: min 1, equals the length of `record_ids`.

class_counts.meaning: Executions by failure class. Constraint: the counts sum to `execution_count`.

counted_count.meaning: Executions that count against the pass rate. Constraint: min 0, equals `execution_count` minus the `infrastructure` and `scientific` counts.

gate_pass_rate.meaning: Share of counted executions that the gate advanced. Constraint: min 0, max 1. Equals the `none` count divided by `counted_count`, rounded to six decimals. Null when `counted_count` is 0.

verdict_counts.meaning: Gate verdicts of the executions that reached the gate.

check_rates.meaning: Pass rate of each declared check. Constraint: at most 64, unique `check_id`.

failure_reasons.meaning: Most common declared failure reason codes. Constraint: at most 20, most frequent first.

error_fingerprints.meaning: Most common error fingerprints. Constraint: at most 20, most frequent first.

undeclared_behavior_count.meaning: Items with status `undeclared` across the scored conformance records. Constraint: min 0, equals the sum of `undeclared_count` over `conformance_refs`.

mean_declaration_coverage.meaning: Mean `coverage` of the scored conformance records. Constraint: min 0, max 1. The mean of `coverage` over `conformance_refs`, rounded to six decimals. Null when no conformance record has a coverage.

next_node_acceptance_rate.meaning: Share of outputs that the next node accepted, matched by file hash. Constraint: min 0, max 1. Null when unavailable.

median_duration_s.meaning: Typical duration. Constraint: min 0. Null when no execution has a measured duration.

median_total_tokens.meaning: Typical token use, input plus output. Constraint: min 0. Null when no execution has token counts.

median_attempts.meaning: Typical number of attempts. Constraint: min 1.

unavailable_reasons.meaning: Measures that could not be computed, and why. Constraint: at most 50.

interfaces.name: sample-run-export
consumers: offline development of the verifier CC
interfaces.failure: An export whose content hash, labels or call folders do not match its files is refused. An interrupted export is discarded and a later export gets a new ID. Consumers read it and never write into it.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Export ID. A changed export gets a new ID. Constraint: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`, equals the export folder name.

built_at.meaning: When the builder wrote the export. Constraint: UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

records_ref.meaning: The exported records, one line per entry. Constraint: the `records.jsonl` inside the export folder.

bundle_refs.meaning: Run bundle manifests of the exported runs. Constraint: 1 to 500, one run bundle per run in `entries`.

entries.meaning: The exported executions. Failed executions are included. Constraint: 1 to 5000, unique `observation_id`.

files.meaning: Every file in the export folder except `export.json`. Constraint: 1 to 100000, unique `path`.

content_sha256.meaning: One hash for the whole export, so everyone can confirm they use the same data. Constraint: see the rule below.

omitted.meaning: Executions or files left out, with the reason. Constraint: at most 100.

redactions.meaning: What this audience does not see, and why. Protected evaluation data is always listed here when present. Constraint: at most 100.
